  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;
  background:rgba(10,12,17,.55);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  border-bottom:1px solid transparent;
  transition:background .3s ease,border-color .3s ease;
}
.site-header.scrolled{background:rgba(10,12,17,.88);border-bottom-color:var(--line)}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:72px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:800;font-size:1.06rem;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.brand-mark{
  width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--grad-red);
  display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 6px 18px -6px rgba(255,71,87,.7);
}
.brand-mark svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.brand em{font-style:normal;background:var(--grad-red);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;list-style:none}
.nav-links a{
  font-size:.9rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);
  padding:9px 14px;border-radius:9px;transition:color .2s,background .2s;
}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--text);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.nav-cta{margin-left:10px}
.nav-cta .btn{padding:10px 18px;font-size:.88rem}
.nav-toggle{
  display:none;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:10px;
  width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:10px;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:5px;
}
.nav-toggle span{display:block;width:20px;height:2px;background:var(--text);border-radius:2px;transition:transform .3s ease,opacity .3s ease}
.site-header.menu-open .nav-toggle span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(7px) rotate(45deg)}
.site-header.menu-open .nav-toggle span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}
.site-header.menu-open .nav-toggle span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg)}

/* ---------- Hero ---------- */
.hero{
  position:relative;
  padding:170px 0 90px;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(900px 480px at 82% -10%,rgba(255,122,61,.14),transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(1000px 560px at 12% -20%,rgba(255,71,87,.20),transparent 62%),
    var(--bg);
}
.hero::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.032) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.032) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:54px 54px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 95% 75% at 50% 0%,#000 25%,transparent 78%);
  mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 95% 75% at 50% 0%,#000 25%,transparent 78%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.hero-inner{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:56px;align-items:center}
.eyebrow{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
  font-family:var(--font-head);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--red);
  padding:8px 15px;border:1px solid rgba(255,71,87,.3);border-radius:99px;
  background:rgba(255,71,87,.07);
}
.eyebrow .dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);animation:pulse 2s infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:.4;transform:scale(.75)}}
.hero h1{
  font-size:clamp(2.35rem,5.1vw,3.7rem);
  margin:22px 0 20px;
}
.hero h1 .hl{
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,#ff4757 10%,#ff9d4d 90%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
}
.hero-sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:1.08rem;max-width:34rem;margin-bottom:34px}
.hero-sub strong{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}
.hero-ctas{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:52px}

.hero-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:30px}
.stat-num{font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(1.35rem,2.4vw,1.7rem);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.stat-num .suffix{background:var(--grad-gold);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.stat-label{color:var(--faint);font-size:.8rem;margin-top:2px;letter-spacing:.02em}

/* Hero dashboard card */
.dash-wrap{position:relative}
.dash-card{
  position:relative;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,255,255,.055),rgba(255,255,255,.015));
  border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius:20px;
  padding:24px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
}
.dash-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:20px}
.dash-title{font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.dash-title .live{
  font-size:.62rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--green);
  border:1px solid rgba(61,220,151,.35);background:rgba(61,220,151,.08);
  padding:3px 9px;border-radius:99px;
}
.dash-dots{display:flex;gap:6px}
.dash-dots i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
.dash-dots i:first-child{background:rgba(255,71,87,.7)}
.dash-kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-bottom:20px}
.kpi{background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:13px 14px}
.kpi .k-label{font-size:.68rem;color:var(--faint);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.09em}
.kpi .k-val{font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:800;font-size:1.06rem;margin-top:4px}
.kpi .k-delta{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:600;margin-top:3px}
.up{color:var(--green)} .gold{color:var(--gold)}
.chart{
  display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:7px;height:150px;
  padding:16px 8px 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);
}
.chart .bar{
  flex:1;border-radius:5px 5px 2px 2px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.16),rgba(255,255,255,.05));
  position:relative;transform-origin:bottom;
  animation:grow 1.1s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) backwards;
}
.chart .bar.hot{background:var(--grad-red);box-shadow:0 0 22px -4px rgba(255,71,87,.65)}
.chart .bar.hot::after{
  content:"+$12,480";
  position:absolute;top:-30px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  font-size:.66rem;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;
  background:#1c2233;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  padding:3px 9px;border-radius:7px;color:var(--text);
}
.chart-labels{display:flex;gap:7px;padding:8px 8px 2px}
.chart-labels span{flex:1;text-align:center;font-size:.62rem;color:var(--faint)}
@keyframes grow{from{transform:scaleY(0)}to{transform:scaleY(1)}}
.float-chip{
  position:absolute;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
  background:#161b29;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius:12px;padding:10px 15px;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
  animation:floaty 5s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.float-chip .ic{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.float-chip small{display:block;font-weight:500;color:var(--faint);font-size:.68rem}
.chip-1{top:-20px;right:-14px}
.chip-1 .ic{background:rgba(255,71,87,.16);color:var(--red)}
.chip-2{bottom:-18px;left:-16px;animation-delay:2.2s}
.chip-2 .ic{background:rgba(247,194,94,.14);color:var(--gold)}
@keyframes floaty{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-9px)}}

/* ---------- Sections ---------- */
.section{padding:104px 0;position:relative}
.section.alt{background:var(--bg-soft);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.section-head{max-width:640px;margin-bottom:56px}
.section-head.center{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;text-align:center}
.section-head .eyebrow{margin-bottom:18px}
.section-head h2{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.6vw,2.55rem)}
.section-head .lead{color:var(--muted);margin-top:14px;font-size:1.02rem}
.section-head .lead strong{color:var(--text)}

/* ---------- Revenue stream cards ---------- */
.stream-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}
.stream-card{
  position:relative;
  background:var(--surface);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--radius);
  padding:28px 26px;
  transition:transform .3s ease,border-color .3s ease,box-shadow .3s ease;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.stream-card::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--red),transparent 70%);
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s ease;
}
.stream-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:var(--line-strong);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)}
.stream-card:hover::before{opacity:1}
.stream-ic{
  width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:18px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:rgba(255,71,87,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,71,87,.22);color:var(--red);
}
.stream-ic svg{width:21px;height:21px}
.stream-card h3{font-size:1.08rem;margin-bottom:9px}
.stream-card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem}
.stream-tag{
  display:inline-block;margin-top:16px;
  font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;
  color:var(--gold);background:rgba(247,194,94,.08);
  border:1px solid rgba(247,194,94,.25);
  padding:5px 11px;border-radius:99px;
}

/* ---------- Roadmap timeline ---------- */
.timeline{position:relative;max-width:820px;margin:0 auto;padding-left:8px}
.timeline::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:33px;top:10px;bottom:10px;width:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--red) 0%,rgba(255,71,87,.25) 45%,var(--line) 100%);
}
.tl-item{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:66px 1fr;gap:24px;padding:0 0 38px}
.tl-item:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.tl-num{
  width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;
  background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:800;font-size:1.05rem;
  color:var(--red);position:relative;z-index:1;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 6px var(--bg-soft);
}
.tl-card{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--radius);padding:24px 26px;
  transition:transform .3s ease,border-color .3s ease;
}
.tl-card:hover{transform:translateX(6px);border-color:var(--line-strong)}
.tl-card h3{font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:7px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tl-card h3 .chip{
  font-size:.64rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--faint);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:3px 10px;
}
.tl-card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem}
.tl-card ul{margin-top:12px;display:grid;gap:7px;list-style:none}
.tl-card li{position:relative;padding-left:22px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.89rem}
.tl-card li::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:2px;top:8px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:3px;
  background:var(--grad-red);opacity:.85;
}

/* ---------- Calculator ---------- */
.calc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:24px;align-items:stretch}
.calc-panel{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--radius);padding:30px;
}
.calc-panel h3{font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.ctrl{margin-bottom:26px}
.ctrl:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.ctrl-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:11px;gap:12px}
.ctrl-top label{font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600}
.ctrl-val{
  font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:700;font-size:.9rem;
  background:rgba(255,71,87,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,71,87,.25);
  color:#ffb3ba;padding:4px 13px;border-radius:99px;white-space:nowrap;
}
input[type=range]{
  -webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;
  width:100%;height:6px;border-radius:99px;outline:none;cursor:pointer;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--red) var(--fill,50%),rgba(255,255,255,.1) var(--fill,50%));
}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{
  -webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;
  width:19px;height:19px;border-radius:50%;
  background:#fff;border:4px solid var(--red);
  box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
  transition:transform .15s ease;
}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb:hover{transform:scale(1.15)}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-thumb{
  width:15px;height:15px;border-radius:50%;
  background:#fff;border:4px solid var(--red);
  box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-track{height:6px;border-radius:99px;background:transparent}

.result-panel{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(500px 260px at 100% 0%,rgba(255,71,87,.14),transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(160deg,#181e2c,#12161f);
  border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius:var(--radius);
  padding:32px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
}
.result-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:8px}
.result-top .r-label{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--faint);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em}
.result-big{font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(2.2rem,4.5vw,3rem);letter-spacing:-.03em;margin-top:4px}
.result-big .cur{background:var(--grad-gold);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.result-annual{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:24px}
.result-annual strong{color:var(--text)}
.r-rows{display:grid;gap:10px;margin-bottom:24px}
.r-row{
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:11px;padding:12px 16px;font-size:.9rem;
}
.r-row .r-name{color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.r-row .r-name .swatch{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:3px}
.r-row .r-num{font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:700}
.split-bar{display:flex;height:10px;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.split-bar .seg-ad{background:var(--grad-red);transition:width .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.split-bar .seg-sp{background:var(--grad-gold);transition:width .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.split-legend{display:flex;gap:20px;margin-top:11px;font-size:.75rem;color:var(--faint)}
.split-legend i{display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:3px;margin-right:6px}
.lg-ad i{background:var(--red)} .lg-sp i{background:var(--gold)}
.result-note{margin-top:auto;padding-top:20px;font-size:.76rem;color:var(--faint);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}

/* ---------- Requirements ---------- */
.req-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;margin-bottom:40px}
.req-card{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--radius);padding:30px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  transition:transform .3s ease,border-color .3s ease;
}
.req-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--line-strong)}
.req-card.featured{border-color:rgba(255,71,87,.4);background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,71,87,.09),var(--surface) 55%)}
.req-badge{
  position:absolute;top:20px;right:20px;
  font-size:.64rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  background:var(--grad-red);color:#fff;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:99px;
}
.req-card h3{font-size:1.15rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.req-card .req-sub{color:var(--faint);font-size:.84rem;margin-bottom:20px}
.req-list{display:grid;gap:12px}
.req-item{display:flex;gap:13px;align-items:flex-start}
.req-item .check{
  flex:none;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:8px;margin-top:2px;
  background:rgba(61,220,151,.12);border:1px solid rgba(61,220,151,.3);
  display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--green);
}
.req-item .check svg{width:12px;height:12px}
.req-item .r-t{font-weight:600;font-size:.94rem}
.req-item .r-d{color:var(--muted);font-size:.84rem}
.unlocks{margin-top:22px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);font-size:.83rem;color:var(--muted)}
.unlocks strong{color:var(--text)}
.unlocks .tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-top:10px}
.unlocks .tags span{
  font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid var(--line);
  padding:4px 11px;border-radius:99px;
}

.niche-table{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden}
.niche-table h3{font-size:1rem;padding:20px 26px 4px}
.niche-table p{padding:0 26px 16px;color:var(--faint);font-size:.85rem}
.niche-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 2fr .7fr;gap:14px;align-items:center;padding:13px 26px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.9rem}
.niche-row .n-name{font-weight:600}
.niche-bar{height:8px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);overflow:hidden}
.niche-bar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:99px;background:var(--grad-red)}
.niche-row .n-rpm{font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}

/* ---------- Tips ---------- */
.tips-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}
.tip-card{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--radius);padding:26px;
  display:flex;gap:16px;
  transition:transform .3s ease,border-color .3s ease;
}
.tip-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--line-strong)}
.tip-num{
  flex:none;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:11px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:800;font-size:.95rem;
  color:var(--gold);background:rgba(247,194,94,.09);border:1px solid rgba(247,194,94,.25);
}
.tip-card h3{font-size:.99rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.tip-card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.88rem}

/* ---------- FAQ ---------- */
.faq-list{max-width:780px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;gap:12px}
.faq-item{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .3s ease;
}
.faq-item.open{border-color:rgba(255,71,87,.4)}
.faq-q{
  width:100%;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:18px;
  padding:20px 24px;text-align:left;
  font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;color:var(--text);
}
.faq-q .chev{
  flex:none;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid var(--line);
  transition:transform .35s ease,background .3s ease;
  color:var(--muted);
}
.faq-item.open .faq-q .chev{transform:rotate(180deg);background:rgba(255,71,87,.14);color:var(--red)}
.faq-q .chev svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.faq-a{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .4s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.faq-a>div{overflow:hidden}
.faq-a p{padding:0 24px 22px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem;max-width:64ch}
.faq-a p strong{color:var(--text)}

/* ---------- CTA banner ---------- */
.cta-banner{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(600px 300px at 15% 120%,rgba(255,122,61,.22),transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(135deg,#1a1014 0%,#141824 55%,#101420 100%);
  border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius:22px;padding:56px 48px;
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:32px;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.cta-banner h2{font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.1rem);margin-bottom:10px}
.cta-banner p{color:var(--muted);max-width:34rem}

/* ---------- Footer ---------- */
footer{background:var(--bg-soft);border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:64px 0 32px}
.foot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr;gap:40px;margin-bottom:44px}
.foot-brand p{color:var(--faint);font-size:.88rem;margin-top:14px;max-width:26rem}
.foot-col h4{font-size:.8rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--faint);margin-bottom:16px;font-weight:700}
.foot-col ul{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:10px}
.foot-col a{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;transition:color .2s}
.foot-col a:hover{color:var(--red)}
.foot-bottom{
  border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:26px;
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  color:var(--faint);font-size:.78rem;
}

/* ---------- Back to top ---------- */
.to-top{
  position:fixed;right:24px;bottom:24px;z-index:90;
  width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:13px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  background:rgba(20,24,36,.85);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
  color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(12px);
  transition:opacity .3s ease,transform .3s ease,background .2s;
}
.to-top.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:none}
.to-top:hover{background:var(--grad-red)}
.to-top svg{width:18px;height:18px}

/* ---------- Reveal on scroll ---------- */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .75s ease,transform .75s ease}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.d1{transition-delay:.08s}.d2{transition-delay:.16s}.d3{transition-delay:.24s}
.d4{transition-delay:.32s}.d5{transition-delay:.4s}

/* ---------- Responsive ---------- */
@media(max-width:1020px){
  .hero-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:64px}
  .hero-sub{max-width:42rem}
  .dash-wrap{max-width:600px}
  .stream-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .tips-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}

  .chip-1{right:6px;top:-16px}
  .chip-2{left:6px;bottom:-16px}
  .timeline::before{left:27px}
  .tl-item{grid-template-columns:54px 1fr;gap:16px}
  .tl-num{width:44px;height:44px;font-size:.95rem;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px var(--bg-soft)}

  .niche-row .n-rpm{text-align:left}
  .calc-panel,.result-panel{padding:24px 20px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){

  .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}
}

      </div>
      <div class="timeline">
        <div class="tl-item reveal">
          <div class="tl-num">01</div>
          <div class="tl-card">
            <h3>Pick a profitable niche <span class="chip">Week 1</span></h3>
            <p>Success starts before the camera turns. Choose the intersection of your expertise, viewer demand and advertiser spend.</p>
            <ul>
              <li>Shortlist 3 niches, study the top 20 channels in each</li>
              <li>Check RPM ranges — finance and tech pay 5–10× more than entertainment</li>
              <li>Find a gap: a format, audience or angle the leaders aren't covering</li>

        </div>
        <div class="tl-item reveal">
          <div class="tl-num">02</div>
          <div class="tl-card">
            <h3>Build a lean studio <span class="chip">Week 1–2</span></h3>
            <p>Viewers forgive a modest set. They never forgive bad audio. Start with the cheapest professional stack:</p>
            <ul>
              <li>Phone or mirrorless camera + natural or $60 key light</li>
              <li>$50–150 lavalier or condenser mic — audio is 80% of perceived quality</li>
              <li>Clean background, consistent framing, total budget under $400</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="tl-item reveal">
          <div class="tl-num">03</div>
          <div class="tl-card">
            <h3>Write scripts that hold attention <span class="chip">Every video</span></h3>
            <p>YouTube rewards watch time, so structure is everything. Use the proven four-beat frame:</p>
            <ul>
              <li>Hook (0:00–0:15): state the payoff, create an open loop</li>
              <li>Promise: tell viewers exactly what they'll get</li>
              <li>Payoff loop: 3–5 value beats with mini-hooks in between</li>
              <li>Close: CTA to one next action — subscribe or click the next video</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="tl-item reveal">
          <div class="tl-num">04</div>
          <div class="tl-card">
            <h3>Shoot & edit for retention <span class="chip">Every video</span></h3>
            <p>The edit is where retention is won or lost. Keep the momentum high:</p>
            <ul>
              <li>Cut every 3–7 seconds; change angle, b-roll or graphic on each beat</li>
              <li>On-screen captions for key lines — 80% watch on mobile, often muted</li>
              <li>End screens that push into your best-performing video, not "subscribe"</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="tl-item reveal">
          <div class="tl-num">05</div>
          <div class="tl-card">
            <h3>Design the click <span class="chip">Before publishing</span></h3>
            <p>Make the thumbnail and title before the video — if the concept can't be packaged, it can't win.</p>
            <ul>
              <li>Thumbnails: 3 words max, one clear subject, high contrast</li>
              <li>Titles: curiosity + specificity ("I Tested 7 Microphones — Only 2 Work")</li>
              <li>A/B test with YouTube's Test & Compare; target 4–10% CTR</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="tl-item reveal">
          <div class="tl-num">06</div>
          <div class="tl-card">
            <h3>Publish on a schedule <span class="chip">Ongoing</span></h3>
            <p>Consistency compounds. The algorithm favors channels that keep the feed full and the audience returning.</p>
            <ul>
              <li>1–2 long-form videos per week + 2–3 Shorts from the same content</li>
              <li>Batch filming: 4–6 videos in a single session</li>
              <li>Never break the streak — even at 100 subscribers</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="tl-item reveal">
          <div class="tl-num">07</div>
          <div class="tl-card">
            <h3>Read the numbers like a trader <span class="chip">Weekly</span></h3>
            <p>Analytics are your dashboard. Two numbers matter most; everything else is noise:</p>
            <ul>
              <li>CTR below 3% → new thumbnail/title. Average view duration below 40% → new hook/edit</li>
              <li>Double down on winning formats; kill what underperforms after 5 attempts</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="tl-item reveal">
          <div class="tl-num">08</div>
          <div class="tl-card">

              <li>Launch a product or course once you've documented your method</li>

        </div>

That said, the best niche is one where you can produce consistently for 100+ videos. A passion niche with strong affiliate products can out-earn a high-RPM niche you can't sustain.</p></div></div>

AdSense is the baseline that proves your audience is valuable; sponsors and your own products are where the real business lives.</p></div></div>

<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";

  /* ---------- Header state ---------- */
  var header = document.getElementById('siteHeader');
  var toTop  = document.getElementById('toTop');
  function onScroll(){
    var y = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
    header.classList.toggle('scrolled', y > 12);
    toTop.classList.toggle('show', y > 640);
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, {passive:true});
  onScroll();
  toTop.addEventListener('click', function(){ window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'smooth'}); });

  /* ---------- Mobile nav ---------- */
  var toggle = document.getElementById('navToggle');
  toggle.addEventListener('click', function(){
    var open = header.classList.toggle('menu-open');
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('#navLinks a').forEach(function(a){
    a.addEventListener('click', function(){
      header.classList.remove('menu-open');
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    });
  });

  /* ---------- Reveal on scroll ---------- */
  var revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window){
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(e){
        if (e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); }
      });
    }, {threshold:0.12, rootMargin:'0px 0px -40px 0px'});
    revealEls.forEach(function(el){ io.observe(el); });
  } else {
    revealEls.forEach(function(el){ el.classList.add('in'); });
  }

  /* ---------- Animated counters ---------- */
  function animateCount(el){
    var target = parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-count'));
    var dec = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-decimals') || '0', 10);
    var dur = 1500, start = null;
    function frame(ts){
      if (!start) start = ts;
      var p = Math.min((ts - start) / dur, 1);
      var eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
      var val = target * eased;
      el.textContent = dec > 0 ? val.toFixed(dec) : Math.round(val).toLocaleString('en-US');
      if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  var counters = document.querySelectorAll('[data-count]');
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window){
    var cio = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(e){
        if (e.isIntersecting){ animateCount(e.target); cio.unobserve(e.target); }
      });
    }, {threshold:0.5});
    counters.forEach(function(el){ cio.observe(el); });
  } else {
    counters.forEach(function(el){
      var dec = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-decimals') || '0', 10);
      var t = parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-count'));
      el.textContent = dec > 0 ? t.toFixed(dec) : t.toLocaleString('en-US');
    });
  }

  /* ---------- FAQ accordion ---------- */
  var faqs = document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item');
  faqs.forEach(function(item){
    var q = item.querySelector('.faq-q');
    q.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
      faqs.forEach(function(other){
        other.classList.remove('open');
        other.querySelector('.faq-q').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
      });
      if (!isOpen){
        item.classList.add('open');
        q.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
      }
    });
  });

  /* ---------- Revenue calculator ---------- */
  var usd = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency',currency:'USD',maximumFractionDigits:0});
  var usd2 = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency',currency:'USD',minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2});
  var numFmt = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US');

  var views = document.getElementById('views');
  var rpm   = document.getElementById('rpm');
  var deals = document.getElementById('deals');
  var dealSize = document.getElementById('dealSize');

  var viewsVal = document.getElementById('viewsVal');
  var rpmVal   = document.getElementById('rpmVal');
  var dealsVal = document.getElementById('dealsVal');
  var dealSizeVal = document.getElementById('dealSizeVal');

  var totalMo = document.getElementById('totalMo');
  var totalYr = document.getElementById('totalYr');
  var adRev   = document.getElementById('adRev');
  var spRev   = document.getElementById('spRev');
  var blended = document.getElementById('blended');
  var segAd   = document.getElementById('segAd');
  var segSp   = document.getElementById('segSp');
  var adPct   = document.getElementById('adPct');
  var spPct   = document.getElementById('spPct');

  function setFill(input){
    var min = parseFloat(input.min), max = parseFloat(input.max), val = parseFloat(input.value);
    var pct = ((val - min) / (max - min)) * 100;
    input.style.setProperty('--fill', pct + '%');
  }

  function updateCalc(){
    var v = parseFloat(views.value);
    var r = parseFloat(rpm.value);
    var d = parseInt(deals.value, 10);
    var s = parseFloat(dealSize.value);

    var ad = (v * r) / 1000;
    var sp = d * s;
    var total = ad + sp;

    viewsVal.textContent = numFmt.format(v);
    rpmVal.textContent = '$' + r.toFixed(2);
    dealsVal.textContent = d;
    dealSizeVal.textContent = usd.format(s);

    totalMo.textContent = numFmt.format(Math.round(total));
    totalYr.textContent = usd.format(Math.round(total * 12));
    adRev.textContent = usd.format(Math.round(ad));
    spRev.textContent = usd.format(Math.round(sp));
    blended.textContent = usd2.format(total / (v / 1000));

    var adShare = total > 0 ? Math.round((ad / total) * 100) : 0;
    var spShare = total > 0 ? 100 - adShare : 0;
    segAd.style.width = adShare + '%';
    segSp.style.width = spShare + '%';
    adPct.textContent = adShare + '%';
    spPct.textContent = spShare + '%';

    [views, rpm, deals, dealSize].forEach(setFill);
  }

  [views, rpm, deals, dealSize].forEach(function(inp){
    inp.addEventListener('input', updateCalc);
  });
  updateCalc();

  /* ---------- Footer year ---------- */
  document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
})();
</script>
</body>

.brand-mark svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.brand em{font-style:normal;background:var(--grad-red);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;list-style:none}
.nav-links a{
  font-size:.9rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);
  padding:9px 14px;border-radius:9px;transition:color .2s,background .2s;
}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--text);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.nav-cta{margin-left:10px}
.nav-cta .btn{padding:10px 18px;font-size:.88rem}
.nav-toggle{
  display:none;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:10px;
  width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:10px;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:5px;
}
.nav-toggle span{display:block;width:20px;height:2px;background:var(--text);border-radius:2px;transition:transform .3s ease,opacity .3s ease}
.site-header.menu-open .nav-toggle span:nth-child(1){transform:translateY(7px) rotate(45deg)}
.site-header.menu-open .nav-toggle span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}
.site-header.menu-open .nav-toggle span:nth-child(3){transform:translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg)}

/* ---------- Hero ---------- */
.hero{
  position:relative;
  padding:170px 0 90px;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(900px 480px at 82% -10%,rgba(255,122,61,.14),transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(1000px 560px at 12% -20%,rgba(255,71,87,.20),transparent 62%),
    var(--bg);
}
.hero::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.032) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.032) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:54px 54px;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 95% 75% at 50% 0%,#000 25%,transparent 78%);
  mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 95% 75% at 50% 0%,#000 25%,transparent 78%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.hero-inner{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:56px;align-items:center}
.eyebrow{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
  font-family:var(--font-head);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--red);
  padding:8px 15px;border:1px solid rgba(255,71,87,.3);border-radius:99px;
  background:rgba(255,71,87,.07);
}
.eyebrow .dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);animation:pulse 2s infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:.4;transform:scale(.75)}}
.hero h1{
  font-size:clamp(2.35rem,5.1vw,3.7rem);
  margin:22px 0 20px;
}
.hero h1 .hl{
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,#ff4757 10%,#ff9d4d 90%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
}
.hero-sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:1.08rem;max-width:34rem;margin-bottom:34px}
.hero-sub strong{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}
.hero-ctas{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:52px}

.hero-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:30px}
.stat-num{font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(1.35rem,2.4vw,1.7rem);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.stat-num .suffix{background:var(--grad-gold);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.stat-label{color:var(--faint);font-size:.8rem;margin-top:2px;letter-spacing:.02em}

/* Hero dashboard card */
.dash-wrap{position:relative}
.dash-card{
  position:relative;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,255,255,.055),rgba(255,255,255,.015));
  border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius:20px;
  padding:24px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
}
.dash-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:20px}
.dash-title{font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.dash-title .live{
  font-size:.62rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--green);
  border:1px solid rgba(61,220,151,.35);background:rgba(61,220,151,.08);
  padding:3px 9px;border-radius:99px;
}
.dash-dots{display:flex;gap:6px}
.dash-dots i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14)}
.dash-dots i:first-child{background:rgba(255,71,87,.7)}
.dash-kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-bottom:20px}
.kpi{background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:13px 14px}
.kpi .k-label{font-size:.68rem;color:var(--faint);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.09em}
.kpi .k-val{font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:800;font-size:1.06rem;margin-top:4px}
.kpi .k-delta{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:600;margin-top:3px}
.up{color:var(--green)} .gold{color:var(--gold)}
.chart{
  display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:7px;height:150px;
  padding:16px 8px 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);
}
.chart .bar{
  flex:1;border-radius:5px 5px 2px 2px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.16),rgba(255,255,255,.05));
  position:relative;transform-origin:bottom;
  animation:grow 1.1s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) backwards;
}
.chart .bar.hot{background:var(--grad-red);box-shadow:0 0 22px -4px rgba(255,71,87,.65)}
.chart .bar.hot::after{
  content:"+$12,480";
  position:absolute;top:-30px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  font-size:.66rem;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;
  background:#1c2233;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  padding:3px 9px;border-radius:7px;color:var(--text);
}
.chart-labels{display:flex;gap:7px;padding:8px 8px 2px}
.chart-labels span{flex:1;text-align:center;font-size:.62rem;color:var(--faint)}
@keyframes grow{from{transform:scaleY(0)}to{transform:scaleY(1)}}
.float-chip{
  position:absolute;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
  background:#161b29;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius:12px;padding:10px 15px;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);
  animation:floaty 5s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.float-chip .ic{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.float-chip small{display:block;font-weight:500;color:var(--faint);font-size:.68rem}
.chip-1{top:-20px;right:-14px}
.chip-1 .ic{background:rgba(255,71,87,.16);color:var(--red)}
.chip-2{bottom:-18px;left:-16px;animation-delay:2.2s}
.chip-2 .ic{background:rgba(247,194,94,.14);color:var(--gold)}
@keyframes floaty{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-9px)}}

/* ---------- Sections ---------- */
.section{padding:104px 0;position:relative}
.section.alt{background:var(--bg-soft);border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.section-head{max-width:640px;margin-bottom:56px}
.section-head.center{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;text-align:center}
.section-head .eyebrow{margin-bottom:18px}
.section-head h2{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.6vw,2.55rem)}
.section-head .lead{color:var(--muted);margin-top:14px;font-size:1.02rem}
.section-head .lead strong{color:var(--text)}

/* ---------- Revenue stream cards ---------- */
.stream-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}
.stream-card{
  position:relative;
  background:var(--surface);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--radius);
  padding:28px 26px;
  transition:transform .3s ease,border-color .3s ease,box-shadow .3s ease;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.stream-card::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--red),transparent 70%);
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s ease;
}
.stream-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:var(--line-strong);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)}
.stream-card:hover::before{opacity:1}
.stream-ic{
  width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:18px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:rgba(255,71,87,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,71,87,.22);color:var(--red);
}
.stream-ic svg{width:21px;height:21px}
.stream-card h3{font-size:1.08rem;margin-bottom:9px}
.stream-card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem}
.stream-tag{
  display:inline-block;margin-top:16px;
  font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;
  color:var(--gold);background:rgba(247,194,94,.08);
  border:1px solid rgba(247,194,94,.25);
  padding:5px 11px;border-radius:99px;
}

/* ---------- Roadmap timeline ---------- */
.timeline{position:relative;max-width:820px;margin:0 auto;padding-left:8px}
.timeline::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:33px;top:10px;bottom:10px;width:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--red) 0%,rgba(255,71,87,.25) 45%,var(--line) 100%);
}
.tl-item{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:66px 1fr;gap:24px;padding:0 0 38px}
.tl-item:last-child{padding-bottom:0}
.tl-num{
  width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;
  background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:800;font-size:1.05rem;
  color:var(--red);position:relative;z-index:1;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 6px var(--bg-soft);
}
.tl-card{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--radius);padding:24px 26px;
  transition:transform .3s ease,border-color .3s ease;
}
.tl-card:hover{transform:translateX(6px);border-color:var(--line-strong)}
.tl-card h3{font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:7px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tl-card h3 .chip{
  font-size:.64rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--faint);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:3px 10px;
}
.tl-card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem}
.tl-card ul{margin-top:12px;display:grid;gap:7px;list-style:none}
.tl-card li{position:relative;padding-left:22px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.89rem}
.tl-card li::before{
  content:"";position:absolute;left:2px;top:8px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:3px;
  background:var(--grad-red);opacity:.85;
}

/* ---------- Calculator ---------- */
.calc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:24px;align-items:stretch}
.calc-panel{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--radius);padding:30px;
}
.calc-panel h3{font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.ctrl{margin-bottom:26px}
.ctrl:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.ctrl-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:11px;gap:12px}
.ctrl-top label{font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600}
.ctrl-val{
  font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:700;font-size:.9rem;
  background:rgba(255,71,87,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,71,87,.25);
  color:#ffb3ba;padding:4px 13px;border-radius:99px;white-space:nowrap;
}
input[type=range]{
  -webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;
  width:100%;height:6px;border-radius:99px;outline:none;cursor:pointer;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--red) var(--fill,50%),rgba(255,255,255,.1) var(--fill,50%));
}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{
  -webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;
  width:19px;height:19px;border-radius:50%;
  background:#fff;border:4px solid var(--red);
  box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
  transition:transform .15s ease;
}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb:hover{transform:scale(1.15)}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-thumb{
  width:15px;height:15px;border-radius:50%;
  background:#fff;border:4px solid var(--red);
  box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-track{height:6px;border-radius:99px;background:transparent}

.result-panel{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(500px 260px at 100% 0%,rgba(255,71,87,.14),transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(160deg,#181e2c,#12161f);
  border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius:var(--radius);
  padding:32px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
}
.result-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:8px}
.result-top .r-label{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--faint);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em}
.result-big{font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(2.2rem,4.5vw,3rem);letter-spacing:-.03em;margin-top:4px}
.result-big .cur{background:var(--grad-gold);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.result-annual{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:24px}
.result-annual strong{color:var(--text)}
.r-rows{display:grid;gap:10px;margin-bottom:24px}
.r-row{
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:11px;padding:12px 16px;font-size:.9rem;
}
.r-row .r-name{color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.r-row .r-name .swatch{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:3px}
.r-row .r-num{font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:700}
.split-bar{display:flex;height:10px;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.split-bar .seg-ad{background:var(--grad-red);transition:width .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.split-bar .seg-sp{background:var(--grad-gold);transition:width .5s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.split-legend{display:flex;gap:20px;margin-top:11px;font-size:.75rem;color:var(--faint)}
.split-legend i{display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:3px;margin-right:6px}
.lg-ad i{background:var(--red)} .lg-sp i{background:var(--gold)}
.result-note{margin-top:auto;padding-top:20px;font-size:.76rem;color:var(--faint);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}

/* ---------- Requirements ---------- */
.req-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;margin-bottom:40px}
.req-card{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--radius);padding:30px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  transition:transform .3s ease,border-color .3s ease;
}
.req-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--line-strong)}
.req-card.featured{border-color:rgba(255,71,87,.4);background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(255,71,87,.09),var(--surface) 55%)}
.req-badge{
  position:absolute;top:20px;right:20px;
  font-size:.64rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  background:var(--grad-red);color:#fff;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:99px;
}
.req-card h3{font-size:1.15rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.req-card .req-sub{color:var(--faint);font-size:.84rem;margin-bottom:20px}
.req-list{display:grid;gap:12px}
.req-item{display:flex;gap:13px;align-items:flex-start}
.req-item .check{
  flex:none;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:8px;margin-top:2px;
  background:rgba(61,220,151,.12);border:1px solid rgba(61,220,151,.3);
  display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--green);
}
.req-item .check svg{width:12px;height:12px}
.req-item .r-t{font-weight:600;font-size:.94rem}
.req-item .r-d{color:var(--muted);font-size:.84rem}
.unlocks{margin-top:22px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);font-size:.83rem;color:var(--muted)}
.unlocks strong{color:var(--text)}
.unlocks .tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-top:10px}
.unlocks .tags span{
  font-size:.72rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid var(--line);
  padding:4px 11px;border-radius:99px;
}

.niche-table{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden}
.niche-table h3{font-size:1rem;padding:20px 26px 4px}
.niche-table p{padding:0 26px 16px;color:var(--faint);font-size:.85rem}
.niche-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 2fr .7fr;gap:14px;align-items:center;padding:13px 26px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.9rem}
.niche-row .n-name{font-weight:600}
.niche-bar{height:8px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);overflow:hidden}
.niche-bar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:99px;background:var(--grad-red)}
.niche-row .n-rpm{font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}

/* ---------- Tips ---------- */
.tips-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}
.tip-card{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--radius);padding:26px;
  display:flex;gap:16px;
  transition:transform .3s ease,border-color .3s ease;
}
.tip-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--line-strong)}
.tip-num{
  flex:none;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:11px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:800;font-size:.95rem;
  color:var(--gold);background:rgba(247,194,94,.09);border:1px solid rgba(247,194,94,.25);
}
.tip-card h3{font-size:.99rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.tip-card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:.88rem}

/* ---------- FAQ ---------- */
.faq-list{max-width:780px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;gap:12px}
.faq-item{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .3s ease;
}
.faq-item.open{border-color:rgba(255,71,87,.4)}
.faq-q{
  width:100%;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:18px;
  padding:20px 24px;text-align:left;
  font-family:var(--font-head);font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;color:var(--text);
}
.faq-q .chev{
  flex:none;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid var(--line);
  transition:transform .35s ease,background .3s ease;
  color:var(--muted);
}
.faq-item.open .faq-q .chev{transform:rotate(180deg);background:rgba(255,71,87,.14);color:var(--red)}
.faq-q .chev svg{width:14px;height:14px}
.faq-a{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .4s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.faq-a>div{overflow:hidden}
.faq-a p{padding:0 24px 22px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem;max-width:64ch}
.faq-a p strong{color:var(--text)}

/* ---------- CTA banner ---------- */
.cta-banner{
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(600px 300px at 15% 120%,rgba(255,122,61,.22),transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(135deg,#1a1014 0%,#141824 55%,#101420 100%);
  border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius:22px;padding:56px 48px;
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:32px;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.cta-banner h2{font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.1rem);margin-bottom:10px}
.cta-banner p{color:var(--muted);max-width:34rem}

/* ---------- Footer ---------- */
footer{background:var(--bg-soft);border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:64px 0 32px}
.foot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr;gap:40px;margin-bottom:44px}
.foot-brand p{color:var(--faint);font-size:.88rem;margin-top:14px;max-width:26rem}
.foot-col h4{font-size:.8rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--faint);margin-bottom:16px;font-weight:700}
.foot-col ul{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:10px}
.foot-col a{color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;transition:color .2s}
.foot-col a:hover{color:var(--red)}
.foot-bottom{
  border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:26px;
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  color:var(--faint);font-size:.78rem;
}

/* ---------- Back to top ---------- */
.to-top{
  position:fixed;right:24px;bottom:24px;z-index:90;
  width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:13px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
  background:rgba(20,24,36,.85);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
  color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;
  opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(12px);
  transition:opacity .3s ease,transform .3s ease,background .2s;
}
.to-top.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:none}
.to-top:hover{background:var(--grad-red)}
.to-top svg{width:18px;height:18px}

/* ---------- Reveal on scroll ---------- */

  .tl-item{grid-template-columns:54px 1fr;gap:16px}

  .calc-panel,.result-panel{padding:24px 20px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){

  .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}
}

  <section class="section" id="roadmap">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="section-head center reveal">

        <h2>From zero to monetized in eight moves</h2>
        <p class="lead">Every successful channel follows the same operating system. Execute this sequence, in order, and the growth math works in your favor.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="timeline">
        <div class="tl-item reveal">
          <div class="tl-num">01</div>
          <div class="tl-card">
            <h3>Pick a profitable niche <span class="chip">Week 1</span></h3>
            <p>Success starts before the camera turns. Choose the intersection of your expertise, viewer demand and advertiser spend.</p>
            <ul>
              <li>Shortlist 3 niches, study the top 20 channels in each</li>
              <li>Check RPM ranges — finance and tech pay 5–10× more than entertainment</li>
              <li>Find a gap: a format, audience or angle the leaders aren't covering</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="tl-item reveal">
          <div class="tl-num">02</div>
          <div class="tl-card">
            <h3>Build a lean studio <span class="chip">Week 1–2</span></h3>
            <p>Viewers forgive a modest set. They never forgive bad audio. Start with the cheapest professional stack:</p>
            <ul>
              <li>Phone or mirrorless camera + natural or $60 key light</li>
              <li>$50–150 lavalier or condenser mic — audio is 80% of perceived quality</li>
              <li>Clean background, consistent framing, total budget under $400</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="tl-item reveal">
          <div class="tl-num">03</div>
          <div class="tl-card">
            <h3>Write scripts that hold attention <span class="chip">Every video</span></h3>
            <p>YouTube rewards watch time, so structure is everything. Use the proven four-beat frame:</p>
            <ul>
              <li>Hook (0:00–0:15): state the payoff, create an open loop</li>
              <li>Promise: tell viewers exactly what they'll get</li>
              <li>Payoff loop: 3–5 value beats with mini-hooks in between</li>
              <li>Close: CTA to one next action — subscribe or click the next video</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="tl-item reveal">
          <div class="tl-num">04</div>
          <div class="tl-card">
            <h3>Shoot & edit for retention <span class="chip">Every video</span></h3>
            <p>The edit is where retention is won or lost. Keep the momentum high:</p>
            <ul>
              <li>Cut every 3–7 seconds; change angle, b-roll or graphic on each beat</li>
              <li>On-screen captions for key lines — 80% watch on mobile, often muted</li>
              <li>End screens that push into your best-performing video, not "subscribe"</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="tl-item reveal">
          <div class="tl-num">05</div>
          <div class="tl-card">
            <h3>Design the click <span class="chip">Before publishing</span></h3>
            <p>Make the thumbnail and title before the video — if the concept can't be packaged, it can't win.</p>
            <ul>
              <li>Thumbnails: 3 words max, one clear subject, high contrast</li>
              <li>Titles: curiosity + specificity ("I Tested 7 Microphones — Only 2 Work")</li>
              <li>A/B test with YouTube's Test & Compare; target 4–10% CTR</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="tl-item reveal">
          <div class="tl-num">06</div>
          <div class="tl-card">
            <h3>Publish on a schedule <span class="chip">Ongoing</span></h3>
            <p>Consistency compounds. The algorithm favors channels that keep the feed full and the audience returning.</p>
            <ul>
              <li>1–2 long-form videos per week + 2–3 Shorts from the same content</li>
              <li>Batch filming: 4–6 videos in a single session</li>
              <li>Never break the streak — even at 100 subscribers</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="tl-item reveal">
          <div class="tl-num">07</div>
          <div class="tl-card">
            <h3>Read the numbers like a trader <span class="chip">Weekly</span></h3>
            <p>Analytics are your dashboard. Two numbers matter most; everything else is noise:</p>
            <ul>
              <li>CTR below 3% → new thumbnail/title. Average view duration below 40% → new hook/edit</li>
              <li>Double down on winning formats; kill what underperforms after 5 attempts</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="tl-item reveal">
          <div class="tl-num">08</div>
          <div class="tl-card">
            <h3>Monetize & scale the machine <span class="chip">Month 6–18</span></h3>
            <p>Once you cross the Partner Program threshold, layer in the high-margin streams:</p>
            <ul>
              <li>YPP ads + memberships + Supers on day one of monetization</li>
              <li>Pitch sponsors from ~10K engaged subscribers; add affiliate links immediately</li>
              <li>Launch a product or course once you've documented your method</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

      </div>
      <div class="req-grid">

          <div class="req-list">
            <div class="req-item">

            <span class="chev"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"/></svg></span>

That said, the best niche is one where you can produce consistently for 100+ videos. A passion niche with strong affiliate products can out-earn a high-RPM niche you can't sustain.</p></div></div>

Sponsorships, affiliate commissions and owned products typically generate more revenue per viewer than ads — and with higher margins. AdSense is the baseline that proves your audience is valuable; sponsors and your own products are where the real business lives.</p></div></div>

<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";

  /* ---------- Header state ---------- */
  var header = document.getElementById('siteHeader');
  var toTop  = document.getElementById('toTop');
  function onScroll(){
    var y = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
    header.classList.toggle('scrolled', y > 12);
    toTop.classList.toggle('show', y > 640);
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, {passive:true});
  onScroll();
  toTop.addEventListener('click', function(){ window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'smooth'}); });

  /* ---------- Mobile nav ---------- */
  var toggle = document.getElementById('navToggle');
  toggle.addEventListener('click', function(){
    var open = header.classList.toggle('menu-open');
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('#navLinks a').forEach(function(a){
    a.addEventListener('click', function(){
      header.classList.remove('menu-open');
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    });
  });

  /* ---------- Reveal on scroll ---------- */
  var revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window){
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(e){
        if (e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); }
      });
    }, {threshold:0.12, rootMargin:'0px 0px -40px 0px'});
    revealEls.forEach(function(el){ io.observe(el); });
  } else {
    revealEls.forEach(function(el){ el.classList.add('in'); });
  }

  /* ---------- Animated counters ---------- */
  function animateCount(el){
    var target = parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-count'));
    var dec = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-decimals') || '0', 10);
    var dur = 1500, start = null;
    function frame(ts){
      if (!start) start = ts;
      var p = Math.min((ts - start) / dur, 1);
      var eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3);
      var val = target * eased;
      el.textContent = dec > 0 ? val.toFixed(dec) : Math.round(val).toLocaleString('en-US');
      if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  var counters = document.querySelectorAll('[data-count]');
  if ('IntersectionObserver' in window){
    var cio = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(e){
        if (e.isIntersecting){ animateCount(e.target); cio.unobserve(e.target); }
      });
    }, {threshold:0.5});
    counters.forEach(function(el){ cio.observe(el); });
  } else {
    counters.forEach(function(el){
      var dec = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-decimals') || '0', 10);
      var t = parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-count'));
      el.textContent = dec > 0 ? t.toFixed(dec) : t.toLocaleString('en-US');
    });
  }

  /* ---------- FAQ accordion ---------- */
  var faqs = document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item');
  faqs.forEach(function(item){
    var q = item.querySelector('.faq-q');
    q.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
      faqs.forEach(function(other){
        other.classList.remove('open');
        other.querySelector('.faq-q').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
      });
      if (!isOpen){
        item.classList.add('open');
        q.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
      }
    });
  });

  /* ---------- Revenue calculator ---------- */
  var usd = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency',currency:'USD',maximumFractionDigits:0});
  var usd2 = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency',currency:'USD',minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2});
  var numFmt = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US');

  var views = document.getElementById('views');
  var rpm   = document.getElementById('rpm');
  var deals = document.getElementById('deals');
  var dealSize = document.getElementById('dealSize');

  var viewsVal = document.getElementById('viewsVal');
  var rpmVal   = document.getElementById('rpmVal');
  var dealsVal = document.getElementById('dealsVal');
  var dealSizeVal = document.getElementById('dealSizeVal');

  var totalMo = document.getElementById('totalMo');
  var totalYr = document.getElementById('totalYr');
  var adRev   = document.getElementById('adRev');
  var spRev   = document.getElementById('spRev');
  var blended = document.getElementById('blended');
  var segAd   = document.getElementById('segAd');
  var segSp   = document.getElementById('segSp');
  var adPct   = document.getElementById('adPct');
  var spPct   = document.getElementById('spPct');

  function setFill(input){
    var min = parseFloat(input.min), max = parseFloat(input.max), val = parseFloat(input.value);
    var pct = ((val - min) / (max - min)) * 100;
    input.style.setProperty('--fill', pct + '%');
  }

  function updateCalc(){
    var v = parseFloat(views.value);
    var r = parseFloat(rpm.value);
    var d = parseInt(deals.value, 10);
    var s = parseFloat(dealSize.value);

    var ad = (v * r) / 1000;
    var sp = d * s;
    var total = ad + sp;

    viewsVal.textContent = numFmt.format(v);
    rpmVal.textContent = '$' + r.toFixed(2);
    dealsVal.textContent = d;
    dealSizeVal.textContent = usd.format(s);

    totalMo.textContent = numFmt.format(Math.round(total));
    totalYr.textContent = usd.format(Math.round(total * 12));
    adRev.textContent = usd.format(Math.round(ad));
    spRev.textContent = usd.format(Math.round(sp));
    blended.textContent = usd2.format(total / (v / 1000));

    var adShare = total > 0 ? Math.round((ad / total) * 100) : 0;
    var spShare = total > 0 ? 100 - adShare : 0;
    segAd.style.width = adShare + '%';
    segSp.style.width = spShare + '%';
    adPct.textContent = adShare + '%';
    spPct.textContent = spShare + '%';

    [views, rpm, deals, dealSize].forEach(setFill);
  }

  [views, rpm, deals, dealSize].forEach(function(inp){
    inp.addEventListener('input', updateCalc);
  });
  updateCalc();

  /* ---------- Footer year ---------- */
  document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
})();
</script>
</body>
